openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: TP-Link CPE710 is an outdoor wireless CPE for 5 GHz with one Ethernet port based on the AP152 reference board.
openwrt_wiki.Antenne: built-in 23dBi high-gain directional 2×2 MIMO antenna and a dedicated metal reflector, with a beamwidth of 9° (Azimuth) and 7° (Elevation)
openwrt_wiki.Funk: MCS 0-9 (256 QAM), up to 867Mbps; DFS channels 36 up to 173 (may vary on each region)
openwrt_wiki.Port/Strom: one PoE 1Gbps LAN port. Power comes from its external 24V, 0.5A power adapter.
openwrt_wiki.TFTP: hold reset button while powering on for around 30-40 seconds; device 192.168.0.254; TFTP server 192.168.0.100; recovery.bin; in U-Boot: run flashimg, setenv boot_part 1, saveenv
openwrt_wiki.Technical Details: ab Stock-Firmware 1.1.2 Build 20251113 prüft U-Boot RSA-Signaturen; OpenWrt-Images über TFTP abgelehnt; kein Downgrade-Weg bekannt; Warnung: nicht auf 1.1.2 oder neuer aktualisieren
openwrt_wiki.Revisionen: 2026-04-25 jehos: "on CPE710 v2, Firmware version 1.1.2 Build 20251113 and later have a locked bootloader"

openwrt_git.Titel: ath79: add support for TP-Link CPE710-v2
openwrt_git.Beschreibung: outdoor wireless CPE for 5 GHz with one Ethernet port based on the AP152 reference board. Compared to the CPE710-v1, the only change observed in hardware is that the mdio address of the ethernet physical changed from 0x4 to 0x0.
openwrt_git.Flash: 16MiB SPI NOR Based on the GD25Q128
openwrt_git.Wi-Fi 5Ghz: ath10k chip (802.11ac for up to 867Mbps on 5GHz wireless data rate), based on the QCA9896
openwrt_git.Flashing: Flash factory image through stock firmware WEB UI or through TFTP; hold reset button while powering on for around 30-40 seconds; recovery.bin; Stock TFTP server IP 192.168.0.100; device 192.168.0.254

openwrt_pr_16637.Titel: ath79: Add support for TP-Link CPE710v2
openwrt_pr_16637.Beschreibung: The v2 uses the same SoC, RAM, Flash, WiFi MAC, etc., as the v1. Differences: MDIO address of the ethernet PHY changed from 0x4 to 0x0; factory image updater requires firmware version > 0.0.X and compatibility level >= 1.
openwrt_pr_16637.timnoack 2024-10-08: I also got pictures of the PCB, including the locations of the UART bootlog pins (no pinheader or test points for them...).
openwrt_pr_16637.andyboeh 2024-10-24: flashed the two devices (both v2) ... put them on a 950m link. They maintain a 260MBit/s link for about 24h now.
